sign.noTokenMessage: Open the link we sent you, exactly as it arrived.
sign.loadFailedTitle: We could not open your documents
sign.documentFailed: This document could not be displayed. Ask the person who prepared it.
sign.emptyPacketTitle: There is nothing here to sign
sign.emptyPacketMessage: These documents were not prepared properly. Tell the person who prepared them.
sign.disclosureFallback: You agree to sign these documents electronically, and your signature counts as a handwritten one. We record the time, this device and the text you were shown.
sign.packetExpiry: These documents can be signed until {when}.
sign.declineLabel: I do not want to sign
sign.declineConfirmMessage: Nothing is sealed and every document is withdrawn, even one you signed here. You can tell us why.
sign.declinedMessage: Nothing was sealed and every document is withdrawn. The person who prepared them will be in touch.
sign.rosterLabel: What you are signing today: {total} documents
sign.movedOn: You have signed the {signed}. Next is the {next}.
sign.pageNoText: This page is a scan, so there is no text on it to read out. Ask the person who prepared it to read it to you before you sign.
sign.pageFailed: This page could not be shown. Do not sign until it is; ask the person who prepared it.
sign.integrityWarning: This document does not match what was prepared. Do not sign; tell the person who prepared it.
sign.consentLabel: I have read the {title} and agree to sign it
sign.signatureTypedNameLabel: Type your name here to sign
sign.signatureTypedFailed: This device could not turn what you typed into a signature. Draw your signature instead.
sign.fullNameLabel: Your legal name, as on your ID
sign.heldNameHint: It must match the name on your verified ID.
sign.postalAddressHint: Used only to send you written notice.
sign.missingPages: Please read every page before signing.
sign.missingConsent: Please tick the box to confirm you have read it.
sign.missingSignature: Please sign in the box above.
sign.missingName: Type your legal name as it appears on your ID.
sign.signUnconfirmed: We did not hear back after your signature was sent, so we cannot yet say whether it was recorded. Do not sign again — check what happened instead.
sign.sealedMessage: Every document is signed and sealed. Keep the fingerprint below: it shows nothing has changed since you signed.
sign.downloadFailed: The download did not finish. Your copies are in the email we sent you.
sign.downloadExpiry: You can download from this screen until {when}. After that, your copies are in the email we sent you.
sign.sealedIntegrityWarning: The copy that downloaded does not match the fingerprint of what you signed, so it was not saved. Your signature is recorded; the copies we email you are the sealed ones.
sign.signedMessage: Others still have to sign before these documents are sealed.
sign.disclosureTick: I have read this and agree to review and sign electronically.
sign.sealedMessageMailed: Every document is signed and sealed. We emailed your copies to {email}. Keep the fingerprint below: it shows nothing has changed since you signed.

nextSteps.consignmentSellsDetail: We tell you the price, and when you are paid.
nextSteps.consignmentTermDetail: We write to you with your choices.
nextSteps.partnerDetail: A deal schedule is signed under this agreement for each deal.

sign.nothingMore: Nothing more is needed from you.

TOKEN_INVALID.title: This signing link is not valid
TOKEN_INVALID.message: Ask the person who prepared it for a new signing link.

TOKEN_EXPIRED.title: This signing link has expired
TOKEN_EXPIRED.message: Signing links last a short while for your safety. Ask for a new one.

TOKEN_CONSUMED.title: This signing link was replaced
TOKEN_CONSUMED.message: A newer link was made for these documents, and only the newest one works. Open the newest link we sent you.

TOKEN_CONFLICT.title: This link is open on another device
TOKEN_CONFLICT.message: For your safety, a signing link works only on the first device that opens it. Carry on there, or ask for a new link.

PACKET_VOIDED.title: These documents were withdrawn
PACKET_VOIDED.message: A newer set replaced them. Ask for the link to the current documents.

PACKET_EXPIRED.title: These documents have expired
PACKET_EXPIRED.message: They were prepared too long ago to sign now. Ask for them to be prepared again.

PACKET_COMPLETED.title: These documents are already signed
PACKET_COMPLETED.message: This link was used when you signed, and it cannot open again. Your sealed copies are in the email we sent you.

PACKET_DECLINED.title: Nothing was signed
PACKET_DECLINED.message: Nothing was sealed and every document is withdrawn. The person who prepared them will be in touch.

DOCUMENT_UNKNOWN.title: That document is not part of this signing
DOCUMENT_UNKNOWN.message: Reload the page to see the documents you were asked to sign.

DOCUMENT_ALREADY_SIGNED.title: You have already signed that one
DOCUMENT_ALREADY_SIGNED.message: Reload the page to carry on with whatever is still left to sign.

PAGES_NOT_VIEWED.title: Please read every page first
PAGES_NOT_VIEWED.message: Move through the whole document, then sign.

PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE.title: That page is not in this document
PAGE_OUT_OF_RANGE.message: Reload the page and read the document through again.

CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Please confirm you agree first
CONSENT_REQUIRED.message: Tick the box confirming you have read the document and agree to sign it.

ESIGN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.title: Please agree to sign electronically first
ESIGN_CONSENT_REQUIRED.message: Read the notice about signing electronically and agree to it before signing anything.

KYC_REQUIRED.title: Your identity check is not recorded yet
KYC_REQUIRED.message: Your identity check is not recorded yet. Ask the person who prepared these documents.

IDENTITY_NAME_MISMATCH.title: That is not the name on your ID
IDENTITY_NAME_MISMATCH.message: This does not match the name on your verified ID. Type your legal name as it appears on your ID.

SIGNER_OUT_OF_ORDER.title: It is not your turn yet
SIGNER_OUT_OF_ORDER.message: Someone else has to sign these documents before you do.

SIGNER_ALREADY_SIGNED.title: You have already signed everything
SIGNER_ALREADY_SIGNED.message: Nothing further is needed from you. You can close this page.

SIGNER_NAME_MISMATCH.title: That is not the name you started signing under
SIGNER_NAME_MISMATCH.message: Everything in this session is signed under one name. Use the name on your earlier signature, or ask for a fresh set of documents.

POSTAL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.title: Your postal address is needed
POSTAL_ADDRESS_REQUIRED.message: Type it on the postal address line, then sign.

SIGNATURE_INVALID.title: That signature could not be read
SIGNATURE_INVALID.message: Clear the signature box and sign again.

SOURCE_MISSING.title: The document could not be loaded
SOURCE_MISSING.message: Ask the person who prepared it to prepare it again.

SOURCE_TAMPERED.title: The document does not match what was prepared
SOURCE_TAMPERED.message: Do not sign. Ask the person who prepared it to prepare it again.

FONT_MISSING.title: The document cannot be drawn right now
FONT_MISSING.message: Nothing has been signed. The documents cannot be drawn until their font is restored; try again later.

CONFLICT.title: This signing was finished elsewhere
CONFLICT.message: Another device completed or withdrew it while this page was open.

sign.staging: Staging · test data, nothing is signed for real
sign.once: This link works once, on this device only.
